notes: Proof-only. measurable_pi_lambda (now a deprecated alias of Measurable.of_eval with a different argument shape) is written `Measurable.of_eval fun v => …` in five places, as in upstream's merged patches. Reused-name audit: measurePreserving_piProdEquiv uses Measure.prod. Every second factor is s-finite by the declaration's own hypotheses: `ν v` is SigmaFinite by [∀ v, SigmaFinite (ν v)], and `Measure.pi fun v => ν v` is a finite product (Fintype V) of sigma-finite measures, so it is sigma-finite. The meaning is unchanged.
